name: step to the zero of a model fitted through the last few points
mechanism: fit a simple model (a line through the last two points, a parabola or an exponential through the last three) and take its zero as the next point; no derivative is needed and convergence is superlinear, but no bracket is kept

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Secant method' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Root finding: 2-point, 1-sided
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Muller's method': 3-point, quadratic interpolation
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Ridder's method': 3-point, exponential scaling

fails_when: divergence when the model is poor; complex iterates for the parabola form
